findings.text: changed_paths lists 24 paths and omits imas_codex/standard_names/worker_tasks/worker_compose_and_validate.py:1501, worker_review_docs.py:157 and worker_review_names.py:1488, all of which the diff rewrites, so the record of what landed is incomplete exactly where a coordinator audits fidelity.

outside_scope names eight of the twenty-three code files written beyond the fence and omits imas_codex/standard_names/review/pipeline.py, promote.py, context.py, campaign_pricing.py, catalog_import.py, edit.py, review/checks.py and the four graph_store modules, so the disclosed overreach understates the gate's real footprint.

the baseline arm's log opens with the pytest banner and carries no revision or tree line, so the baseline_suite.revision of 627f13045 in manifest.md:43 cannot be tied to this log from its own content, unlike baseline-gate.log:1 and final-gate.log:1 which name theirs.

the done_when asks the reader agreement to be shown for the 85 live names, and the record quotes only the pre-change reading ("Name search answered every one of the 85 with no source"); no post-change search over those 85 is recorded, so the live-graph half of that clause rests on the projection being used rather than on a measurement.

the done_when fixes the disposable-graph expectation as seven planted names reporting 2, and the fixture plants an eighth name with a stale-only producer and asserts count==3, so the literal figure the done_when states is asserted nowhere even though the stricter fixture excuses it.

the twelve newly routed claim, promotion and worker Cypher statements are exercised by no gate, because both suite arms in gate-base.log and gate-head2.log ran the default markers that exclude @pytest.mark.graph and d12231ef2 has no execution of them, so a malformed projection composition in any of them would appear first in production.
